text: カードをすてると　できごとも　なくなりますが　よいですか？

structure.en: if you throw away the card

structure.jp: できごとも　なくなりますが
structure.en: the event will also disappear, but

patterns.name: 〜と (if)
patterns.explanation: と after a verb says that when this happens, the next thing follows. カードをすてると = 'if you throw away the card'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が at the end of a part of a sentence means 'but'. なくなりますが = 'it will disappear, but'.
